intro: Made for celebrations big and small. The Aclectic gives everyone a seat at the table, with a bold Gordion finish that turns your dining room into the heart of every gathering.

features.title: Space for everyone together
features.text: Generous top comfortably seats eight, making it ideal for larger families or hosting festive get-togethers at home.

features.title: Gordion pattern with high-gloss charm
features.text: The patterned tabletop reflects light beautifully, creating a cheerful surface where weekday breakfasts or weekend spreads instantly feel brighter and more inviting.

features.title: Sleek metal frame with lasting strength
features.text: Slim black powder-coated legs hold the table steady while leaving legroom open, so you can tuck in comfortably without bumping knees or feeling cramped.

features.title: Durable finish for everyday use
features.text: Made for daily dining, the high-gloss MDF top resists spills and scratches, so family meals, coffee breaks, or kids’ crafts never leave lasting marks.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Aclectic 8-Seater Engineered Wood Rectangular Dining Table
